title: Boots of Persistence

sources.title: Legendary Mobility
markers: | description = You gain {{Cond|Freedom of Movement}} and {{Cond|Longstrider}}.

summary: +1 Dexterity saves. While equipped, gain Freedom of Movement and Longstrider: move 10 ft farther, ignore difficult terrain and magical movement reduction, and resist magical paralysis and restraint.

fields.Effect: +1 Dexterity saves. While equipped, gain Freedom of Movement and Longstrider: move 10 ft farther, ignore difficult terrain and magical movement reduction, and resist magical paralysis and restraint.
